question: US announces end of Iranian blockade by September 30, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
On July 13, 2026, Trump announced the United States would reinstate its naval blockade of Iran, targeting Iranian ships and customers.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the United States government, or an authorized representative of the United States government, publicly and officially announces the end, termination, lifting, or suspension of the United States’ naval blockade on Iranian ships and ships of Iranian customers, between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An announcement qualifies if it communicates that the United States will generally cease blocking vessel traffic for Iranian ships and customers, including an announcement that the blockade will not take effect at all, even if some restrictions remain (for example, an imposition of fees). An announcement does not qualify if it reflects only a limited or partial change that stops short of a general end or suspension of the blockade, for example, an exemption for a specific vessel, cargo, or port.

A qualifying announcement must be a declarative statement of the United States government’s present termination or suspension of the blockade, previously-unannounced prior termination or suspension of the blockade, or definitive decision to terminate or suspend the blockade.

A qualifying announcement must clearly and unambiguously identify the end or suspension of the blockade. Statements that merely allude to, reference, or describe an end to the blockade, without clearly communicating it, do not qualify. The announcement need not use specific terminology or reference the end of a blockade by name; an announcement of a resumption of prior obligations, the maintenance of a status quo, or a return to a previously agreed baseline qualifies, provided the substantive policy of ending or suspending the blockade is clearly and unambiguously communicated.

A qualifying announcement must be made through official channels, by an individual acting in an official capacity. Statements made incidentally or informally in a context not intended for official communication do not qualify.

The following do not qualify:

Anonymous, unattributed, or leaked statements not confirmed as official;
Statements by persons not authorized to speak for the United States government;
Third-party speculation, analysis, or predictions that the United States government will announce or implement an end to the blockade;
Satirical, fabricated, hacked, or impersonated communications; and
Statements that describe a prospective, contingent, probable, or conditional end to the blockade rather than announcing a present and decided position.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes” regardless of whether it is later reversed, or whether the blockade actually ends in practice.

# Research report 1 of 2

## 1. Resolution source
- Resolution depends on an official US government announcement (President, Department of Defense, State Department, CENTCOM and similar). No single URL is given. I could not open Wikipedia, CNN or CENTCOM pages directly because the proxy refused the connection, so the facts below come from search-result summaries.
- 2026-09-13: CENTCOM said its forces had redirected 101 Iranian or Iran-affiliated commercial vessels under the blockade, so it was still being enforced. [Wikipedia timeline via search](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war)
- As of 2026-09-15, Wikipedia lists the second blockade as running from 14 July 2026 to "present." [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_naval_blockade_of_Iran)

## 2. Current status
- I found no qualifying US announcement on or before 2026-09-15. The blockade is active and nothing settles the question yet.
- 2026-09-15: Iran reportedly rejected any negotiations with the US until its demands are met. [Wikipedia timeline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-14: Trump reportedly said he was willing to negotiate a deal with Iran. [Wikipedia timeline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war)
- 2026-09-14: Talks between Iran and Gulf states in Oman on a temporary Hormuz shipping lane were postponed. Iran said Saudi Arabia asked for the delay. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-14/iran-gulf-talks-delayed-as-saudi-arabia-counters-houthi-attacks)
- 2026-09-14: The NYT, citing Iranian and IRGC officials, reported that Tehran was debating whether to return to talks or step up attacks on US targets and shipping. [Wikipedia timeline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war). The memorandum of understanding (MoU) requires Iran to negotiate a Hormuz arrangement with Oman. [Critical Threats](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/iran-update-september-14-2026)
- 2026-09-07: Iran threatened escalation in the Gulf. According to the search summary, Trump rejected diplomacy, called the June agreement one that "isn't worth the paper it's written on," and said the blockade gives the US "almost total control" of Hormuz. I could not confirm the exact quotes in the article. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/07/middleeast/trump-blockade-iran-military-escalation-intl-latam)
- 2026-08-13: Defense Secretary Hegseth said the Navy could hold the blockade "indefinitely." [CoinGape](https://coingape.com/prediction-markets/will-the-us-end-the-iran-blockade-by-september-30-2026/)
- 2026-07-13/14: Trump announced that the blockade would be reinstated after the ceasefire collapsed, and it resumed on July 14. [next.io](https://next.io/prediction-markets/trending/when-will-the-us-announce-the-end-of-the-iranian-blockade)

## 4. Base rates
- The first blockade ran from 2026-04-13 to 2026-06-18, about 9 weeks. Trump ended it with a Truth Social post saying the "Deal with the Islamic Republic of Iran is now complete" and authorizing the "immediate removal of the United States Naval blockade." So there is a precedent for Trump ending a blockade abruptly by social media post once a deal is reached. [PBS](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/deal-is-reached-to-end-iran-war-and-trump-orders-stop-to-us-naval-blockade), [Attack of the Fanboy](https://attackofthefanboy.com/politics/trump-announced-a-complete-ceasefire-with-iran-on-his-birthday-reopening-the-strait-of-hormuz-and-pulling-the-us-naval-blockade-effective-immediately/)
- In April 2026 Trump extended the ceasefire indefinitely but kept the blockade in place. This shows that ceasefires or talks do not automatically end a blockade. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-21/us-iran-peace-talks-uncertain-with-vance-trip-scrapped)
- By 2026-09-15 the second blockade had lasted about 9 weeks, the same length as the first. The question window is about 15 days. In the first episode, a deal was reached and the blockade lifted within days of signs of agreement. In mid-September there is no active US-Iran negotiating track.

## 5. Other forecasts
- An unverified Binance post said the October 31 odds had fallen to about 23%. [Binance Square](https://www.binance.com/square/hashtag/PolymarketOddsIranBlockadeEndFallTo23%25)
- Manifold has a mirror market. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Mana/us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad)
- I could not find a verified Polymarket price as of 2026-09-15.

- The postponed Iran-Gulf/Oman talks on a Hormuz shipping lane could be rescheduled. That would be a possible route to an MoU-style arrangement.
- Tehran's internal decision on whether to return to US talks or escalate attacks on shipping is pending.
- Trump says he is open to a deal. The June precedent shows he can announce an immediate lifting the moment a deal is reached.
- Possible military escalation in the Gulf, including Houthi attacks and Saudi responses, could harden the US position.
- Statements that are conditional or prospective, such as "we will lift the blockade if Iran reopens Hormuz," would not count under the resolution criteria.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

I found no official US announcement ending, lifting or suspending the blockade on or before Sept 15, 2026. The blockade was still being enforced in early September, and the US was escalating, not easing.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria name no URL. Resolution depends on official US statements: the President (including Truth Social), the Defense Department or CENTCOM, and the State Department. I could not fetch CENTCOM or Wikipedia directly because the proxy refused the connection.
- 2026-07-13: Trump announced on Truth Social that the blockade was reinstated, aimed at Iranian ships and customers. CENTCOM began enforcing it at 4 p.m. ET on July 14. [Iran International](https://www.iranintl.com/en/202607135429), [Marine Insight](https://www.marineinsight.com/?p=1894051)
- The latest CENTCOM material I found describes the blockade as resumed on July 14 and ongoing. [CENTCOM](https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PUBLIC-RELEASES/Article/4593050/us-destroys-5-irgc-tankers-after-iran-targets-another-american-warship/)

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-09-15, nothing settles the question.
- 2026-09-07: CNN reported that Washington had dropped talks in favor of an aggressive economic pressure campaign, and Iran was threatening to escalate. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/07/middleeast/trump-blockade-iran-military-escalation-intl-latam)
- 2026-09-07: The Wall Street Journal reported, as cited on Wikipedia, that the blockade had stopped new Iranian oil exports from the Gulf. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_naval_blockade_of_Iran)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-13 to 15: I found no coverage dated to these days.
- 2026-09-08: CENTCOM destroyed five Iranian crude carriers after missile attacks on a US warship. [CENTCOM](https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PUBLIC-RELEASES/Article/4593050/us-destroys-5-irgc-tankers-after-iran-targets-another-american-warship/)
- 2026-09-06: Iran's Supreme National Security Council head announced a planned "exclusion zone" starting at the US blockade line. Iran promoted its military response while the US kept the blockade in place. [PBS](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/iran-claims-a-strike-on-a-u-s-ship-in-the-strait-of-hormuz-but-the-u-s-denies-it), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/6/iran-touts-military-response-as-us-maintains-blockade-hits-tankers)
- 2026-09-05: The US struck three IRGC-linked tankers, including the M/T Downy near Kharg and the M/T Stark 1 near Jask, after Iranian missile fire. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/05/middleeast/iran-us-tanker-kharg-intl), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/5/us-says-it-hit-iran-oil-tankers-helping-finance-regional-proxies)
- 2026-09-01: The US carried out "defensive strikes" on Bandar Abbas, reportedly the first direct strikes in weeks. [Iran International](https://www.iranintl.com/en/202609014336), [Task & Purpose](https://taskandpurpose.com/news/us-strikes-iran-bandar-abbas/)
- 2026-08-13: Hegseth said the US can keep the blockade "indefinitely" while negotiations remain stalled. [Korea Times](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20260814/us-can-keep-naval-blockade-on-iranian-ports-indefinitely-pentagon-chief-says), [Ynet](https://ynetnews.com/article/bkt36doufe)
- 2026-07-08: Trump declared the June memorandum over, and the July reinstatement followed. [Iran International](https://www.iranintl.com/en/202607080326)

## 4. Base rates
- The first phase of the blockade began on 2026-04-13 and lasted about 2 months. It ended when Trump announced on Truth Social that a deal was complete and the blockade would end, after a 14-point memorandum was signed around June 17. CENTCOM then said it had stopped enforcing the blockade. [CBS58](https://cbs58.com/news/trump-and-iran-reach-agreement-that-includes-opening-strait-of-hormuz), [Libertarian Institute](https://libertarianinstitute.org/news/centcom-announces-end-of-us-blockade-on-iran/)
- So there is a precedent: a qualifying announcement came quickly once a deal was signed. Sources disagree on when phase 1 ended, June 18 or May 29.
- The second phase has now lasted about 2 months without a deal. Earlier Polymarket contracts in this series (Aug 7, Aug 22, Sept 7) evidently passed with no announcement, since the blockade was still in force on Sept 7. [Orrery](https://orrery.me/events/us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockade-byptptpt-20260713152715080)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no expert forecasts or Kalshi or Manifold equivalents.

- The UN General Assembly high-level week in late September could serve as a venue for indirect US-Iran contacts, possibly through Qatari or Pakistani mediators.
- Further rounds of Iranian missile fire and US retaliation could make any deal less likely.
- The November midterms put political pressure on oil prices.
- Any signed agreement would likely bring a quick Truth Social or CENTCOM announcement, as happened in June.
